description: This file defines a static helper class LoggerOptionConverter used for converting property values to specific types, performing variable substitution, and handling external references within the log4php framework.

classes.name: LoggerOptionConverter
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to convert property values to specific types, perform variable substitutions, and handle system property references.

methods.name: OptionConverter
methods.description: Constructor for the static class LoggerOptionConverter (no instantiation).

methods.name: concatanateArrays
methods.description: Merges two arrays into one using array_merge.

methods.name: getSystemProperty
methods.description: Reads a property value referenced by a key, searching first in defined constants and then in $_ENV, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: toBoolean
methods.description: Converts a string value to a boolean, with a default fallback.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts a string value to an integer, with a default fallback.

methods.name: toLevel
methods.description: Converts a string value representing a logging level to a LoggerLevel object, supporting custom class levels.

methods.name: toFileSize
methods.description: Converts a string with size suffix (KB, MB, GB) to a float representing bytes.

methods.name: findAndSubst
methods.description: Finds a property value by key and performs variable substitution on it.

methods.name: substVars
methods.description: Performs variable substitution within strings, replacing placeholders with system properties or provided properties.
